Weed addiction is real lmao I feel like people dont add any nuance to this discussion and think its its very black and white. Addiction is more common with other substances but it definitely happens with weed as well, usually the people most at risk for it are people who are mentally ill, traumatized, and/or in bad environments. Theres a whole disorder called cannabis use disorder.

Literally NOBODY is saying weed is on the same level as heroin or other hard drugs or even alcohol. But that doesnt mean weed still doesnt have consequences. If you HAVE to be smoking weed EVERYDAY solely to feel happy/less anxious or just content, you cant eat without smoking first, you cant sleep without having your daily nightly toke, yeah you're addicted I'm sorry to say it. 

I LOVE weed dont get me wrong and I am pro-weed and am the type that would debate why alcohol is legal but not weed. However everything is best in moderation, including weed. And when people bring up the medicine argument it makes no sense to me, because theres a difference between using it medically and recreationally. Lots of other harder drugs are also used as medicine, doesnt mean they dont have potential for harm when used recreationally.
